teaser: Gameweek 10 has a clear split: a handful of teams get a **2/5** fixture, and a few walk into a wall. Getting that right is most of the work this week.
fullWriteup:
The kind fixtures belong to **Arsenal** (home to Hull, 2/5), **Everton** (home to Coventry, 2/5), **Man City** (away at Forest, 2/5), **Liverpool** (away at Palace, 2/5) and **Bournemouth** (away at Ipswich, 2/5). The other side of that coin: **Hull** face a 5/5, while Brentford, Forest, Palace and Sunderland all have a 4/5. If you're holding Sunderland or Palace assets, this is the week to look elsewhere.

**Konsa** is the standout — **form 9.2**, the best in the game right now, at £4.8m, and Arsenal's defence gets the softest fixture on the board. **Gabriel** (form 8.2) is the premium route to the same clean sheet if you can afford it. **Evanilson** at £6.4m is on form 8.5 and travels to Ipswich with a 2/5 rating. **Haaland** on form 7.2 with a kind trip to Forest needs no further explanation at 79% owned.

For a differential, **Hill** at **2.6% owned** is the pick: form 6.5, £5.5m, and he shares that same kind Bournemouth fixture that makes Evanilson so appealing. If you want something further forward, **Ayari** (form 7.0, £5.4m, **1.5% owned**) is interesting, though Brighton's home game with Brentford is only a 3/5 — a punt rather than a plan.
